entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's fine. It works. I just changed my mind.
Okay, so you're just not finding it to be the right fit for you?
I just don't use it. It was an impulse buy, and I was about to list it on some resale site, but thought I'd check here first.
I'm glad you called first. Let me just pull up your order details. I see you received the band 16 days ago. One moment while I review the policy.
Alright, I've got it. Good news. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.
Oh. Fine. I guess that saves me the effort. What do I do?

I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account right now. You'll just need to print it, place the VeloBand back in its original box, and attach the label. You can drop it off at any post office.

I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else I could assist with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
